description: Q15 fixed-point multiply with rounding and saturation
notes: Same semantics as the mult_r basic operator of the ITU-T G.191 Software Tool Library and as Arm SQRDMULH on one 16-bit lane; function written by us. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake already drops the lower clamp (unreachable) and keeps one smin: 8 IR instructions. Only a = b = -32768 saturates. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
